subBasis: Tokens whose value accrues from real business usage — fee capture, burns, buybacks — never memecoins. ETH in scope (gas burns ETH); BTC tracked separately. 12 tiles: board ranks #1–6 · #7 ETH honorary · plus vetted / candidate / tracked names — monitors AAVE (off the board 8/6) · TAO · ENA · ONDO in the table & alerts only. Data basis Aug 24 weekday scored run. Fees, holders revenue and TVL are 30-day rolling windows ending Aug 23 UTC — the last complete UTC day — read fresh from DefiLlama for HYPE · AERO · UNI · JUP · PENDLE · VVV · LIT · PUMP, with AAVE's fees and TVL fresh and its holders revenue WITHDRAWN (the estimate that stood there was retired as a pre-pause number of unknown vintage; the adapter has printed zero for sixty complete days). Prices, market caps and the 24h/7d columns are the Aug 24 intraday basis from the DefiLlama coins API, confidence 0.99 on all 18 instruments. Those are two vintages under one as-of date, which is a stated limitation rather than a slip. ETH's burn is carried, and labelled carried wherever it appears. Net-flow in-legs are repriced to Aug 24 on unchanged token quantities. B is the derived continuous business score carried at the Aug 23 reading; H, grades, board ranks and unlock schedules are unchanged this run. Sparklines: 7-day live, or 30-day baked (daily closes Jul 25 → Aug 23 this bake). Prices: CoinGecko API first, fallbacks Binance → Hyperliquid (live trackers only) · Fees/TVL: DefiLlama · connecting… · auto-refreshes every 3 h while open.

Reading it: the board line above ETH/BTC = the picks are earning their keep; below = you would have done better just holding ETH or BTC. Through the 8/23 close the board stands at 122.50 against ETH 130.26 and BTC 118.45 — a fourth consecutive close above BTC, now by 4.1 points, while ETH stays ahead by 7.8. Every one of the seven seats is now above its 7/23 start: VVV 140.39, HYPE 135.76, ETH 130.26, UNI 114.91, AERO 113.25, PENDLE 112.40, JUP 110.55. That is new — Uniswap sat below start as recently as the 8/19 close, and the six seats excluding it read 123.77, so the spread between the best and worst seat has done more of the work than any single name. Eighteen closes are baked here — the 8/3–8/6, 8/8 and 8/10–8/18 closes ran only in the engine's archive, and the line bridges those spans. An early read rather than a track record. hint11: Sorted by board rank. Click MC/Rev net for cheapest-net-cash-flow-first (the primary dial; net-dilutive and blanks sort last), or any header to re-sort. Fees ann. and Holders rev ann. are ANNUALIZED (30-day run-rate × 12.17). MC for ENA/LIT/JUP/PUMP uses CoinPaprika-implied supply (June-dated stamps — estimates). Trade vol 30d = monthly TRADE VOLUME on the exchange tokens' own markets (blank for non-exchanges): LIT from Lighter's own API (daily ×30); HYPE baked = spot orderbook only (June perp volume ≈ $267B, T3) though live mode adds the perp leg from Hyperliquid's own API; JUP = aggregator leg only. MC/Rev net = MC ÷ (holders rev − next-12-mo supply-in: unlocks + emissions at realized pace, the NETFLOW in-legs) — the multiple AFTER dilution; "net-dilutive" = supply-in currently exceeds holders revenue (sorted after all real multiples); blank where the in-leg is unknown (e.g. LIT's undisclosed vesting). NEW (owner 7/22 late): MC/FDV = dilution headroom (low = deep overhang — HYPE 0.26 · LIT 0.25; ~1.0 = fully diluted — ETH 1.00 · AAVE 0.95); FDV/Rev = the fully-diluted multiple, the overhang-adjusted lens (JUP: ~26.6× on MC → ~56× on FDV).
